hosted_verification_note: Verified locally via Vitest unit suites (liveSse, agora/workshops, sessionExpiry, bff-v1), TypeScript typecheck, contract drift check, production bundle build + credential scan, isolated loopback fixture Playwright E2E, and a 30-second headless Chromium reproduction against the built bundle.
summary: Cap pre-open SSE failure session-refresh probes to at most one POST /bff/auth/refresh per failure streak in both src/lib/bff-v1/sse/liveSse.ts (module-level refreshProbedInStreak beside attempt) and src/lib/bff-v1/agora/workshops.ts (openWorkshopStream closure refreshProbedInStreak beside attempt). Reset attempt and refreshProbedInStreak only when a stream actually opens (or on explicit caller teardown in liveSse), and schedule reconnects after a successful refresh using the exponential backoff schedule instead of resetting attempt to 0 and reconnecting immediately.

reproduction_before_and_after.method: Intercept GET /bff/events/stream in headless Chromium so every connection attempt fails before open (HTTP 502) and answer POST /bff/auth/refresh with HTTP 200 over a 30-second window.

before_fix.cause: On outcome === 'refreshed', both liveSse.ts and agora/workshops.ts set attempt = 0 and reconnected immediately (0ms delay), probing POST /bff/auth/refresh on every subsequent pre-open failure in a tight loop.

acceptance_criteria.1_at_most_one_refresh_per_pre_open_failu: verified: Both connectLiveSse (src/lib/bff-v1/sse/liveSse.ts) and openWorkshopStream (src/lib/bff-v1/agora/workshops.ts) gate refreshBffSessionOutcome on !everOpened && !refreshProbedInStreak, sending at most one POST /bff/auth/refresh per pre-open failure streak and reconnecting with backoff and no refresh on subsequent failures in the streak
acceptance_criteria.2_backoff_attempt_resets_only_on_open: verified: attempt is reset to 0 only when the stream actually opens (EventSource 'open' listener or fetchSse onOpen) or on explicit liveSse teardown; outcome === 'refreshed' no longer resets attempt and schedules reconnect via nextBackoffMs(attempt++, true)
acceptance_criteria.3_thirty_second_pre_open_failure_test: verified: Unit tests in src/lib/bff-v1/__tests__/sse.test.ts and src/lib/bff-v1/agora/workshops.test.ts simulate 30 seconds of pre-open failures with POST /bff/auth/refresh returning 200 and assert exactly 1 refresh call and 4 reconnects (5 total stream attempts, bounded by SSE_RECONNECT_BACKOFF_MS.length)
acceptance_criteria.4_new_streak_after_open_probes_refresh_a: verified: Unit tests in both sse.test.ts and workshops.test.ts verify that opening a stream resets attempt and refreshProbedInStreak, a post-open drop reconnects with backoff and no refresh, and a subsequent pre-open failure on the reconnected stream starts a new streak and probes POST /bff/auth/refresh once again
acceptance_criteria.5_auth_rejected_transient_and_post_open_: verified: Refresh 401/403 (auth_rejected) schedules no reconnect and triggers session-expired handling; transient refresh failure reconnects with backoff; post-open stream drop reconnects with backoff and never probes refresh
acceptance_criteria.6_existing_suites_and_loopback_e2e_green: verified: All 66 bff-v1/auth Vitest files (716 tests) and isolated loopback fixture Playwright E2E specs pass without new skips or weakened assertions

changed_test_assertions_justification.reason: Updated prior #902 tests that explicitly asserted immediate 0ms reconnect on outcome === 'refreshed' to assert that reconnect is scheduled via the backoff timer as required by AC 1 and AC 2.
